data.one_liner: Community-maintained Clerk SDK for user authentication and management in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to authenticate users and manage profiles using Clerk. Provides widgets and utilities for sign-up, sign-in, and handling authentication states.
use_when: You are using Clerk as your authentication and user management backend in a Flutter app
You want pre-built UI components for Clerk authentication flows
avoid_when: You require official, first-party support from Clerk (this SDK is community-maintained)
Your project relies on older versions of Flutter (< 3.27.4) or Dart (< 3.6.2)
strengths: Integrates Clerk sign-up, sign-in, and user management directly into Flutter
Includes helpful widgets like ClerkAuthBuilder and ClerkUserButton
Supports passkeys, Google OAuth, and Sign in with Apple
weaknesses: Currently in Beta, meaning breaking changes should be expected until the 1.0.0 release
Community-maintained and provided as-is without official Clerk support
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the INTERNET permission to Android's AndroidManifest.xml and configuring publishable API keys from the Clerk Dashboard.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you use Firebase as your backend instead of Clerk.
